content: We are designing a Rust file-indexing CLI called EmberIndex. Remember these initial requirements: BLAKE3 content hashes, four concurrent readers, and 1 MiB read buffers. Reply in at most 60 words with the three facts you will retain.
In at most 80 words, propose four Rust modules for EmberIndex and give each one responsibility.
Update one requirement: use six concurrent readers instead of four. Confirm only the changed value in one sentence.
Write a compact Rust struct named ScanConfig containing buffer_bytes and readers. Use the current remembered values and no explanation.
Switch topics briefly: write a three-line haiku about duplicate files. Nothing else.
Back to EmberIndex. In one sentence, state the hashing algorithm, current reader count, and read-buffer size.
What was the first project name I gave you, and which requirement changed later? Answer in at most 40 words.
Return exactly five short lines labeled Project, Hash, Readers, Buffer, and Config. Fill them with the final remembered EmberIndex values; do not add prose.
